name: workspace-launch
title: ejm-ide
caption: ejm-ide on launch: the project tree, orders.rs from the harbor sample with syntax colors, and Edi's chat pane before a model is connected.
captureMethod: Screenshot of the running ejm-ide desktop app window, captured with macOS desktop control
how: Launched the debug build of the desktop app with the harbor sample as the workspace, switched nothing, clicked nothing and typed nothing, then captured the window; the window shows its launch state with no model connected, so no chat turn, tool call or diff appears.
themeNote: The app theme preference was System and the macOS appearance was dark. A light capture was not made: the only way to set the theme is the app's Preferences (stored in the webview's localStorage key ejm-ide.theme), with no documented environment variable, config file or flag.
frontendSource: Clean export of the ejm-ide commit above (git archive HEAD) served by its own Vite dev server on http://localhost:1420. Its @ejm/* packages resolved to the live sibling ejm-ui working tree (HEAD 111f535 plus uncommitted changes at the time), so the frontend is not purely the committed ejm-ide plus committed ejm-ui.
rustSource: Clean export of the same commit, built with cargo build --offline --locked (rustc 1.99.1) against ejm-harness at the pinned revision 4a751c6a3f24d7d143140f79ff53517fb93e3531 (git archive of that revision). The ejm-ide Rust sources are identical between the earlier commit ca0d317 and this commit.

binary.path: target/debug/ejm-ide (a debug build from the clean export, in a scratch build directory outside the product repository)
binary.launchedAs: a copy inside a minimal ejm-ide.app wrapper (CFBundleIdentifier dev.ejmlabs.ide, ad-hoc signed) so desktop control could target it; the binary itself is unchanged apart from the signature

captureTool: macOS screencapture -x -o -l <window id>, window only, run from the owner's terminal; the PNG is unedited
workspace: a copy of examples/harbor from the same commit, opened through the documented EJM_IDE_WORKSPACE variable, with a one-commit throwaway git history (author Demo)
profile: a fresh isolated HOME (no providers, chats or settings)
steps: git archive HEAD of ejm-ide into a scratch folder; start its Vite dev server on port 1420
open -g -n --env HOME=<isolated home> --env EJM_IDE_WORKSPACE=<copy of examples/harbor> ejm-ide.app
model: none. No provider was connected, no model or fixture was used, and no chat turn ran.
